text:
Emily: Quick check-in: ran a long-session replay with the pagechain coalescing patch on staging. Observations: KV memory growth curve is flatter past ~8k tokens, but eviction churn (evictions/sec) increased during peaks. Posting metrics & profiler snippets.

Raj: Did you run a baseline without the patch for comparison?

Emily: Yes — baseline had steady residency ~72% after warmup. New patch shows residency ~68% but reuse rate improved for hot prefixes. Eviction spikes align with sequence boundary alignments (users hitting many short prefixes back-to-back).

Sofia: Can you paste the PromQL / sample numbers you used?

Emily: Sure — quick cuts below.
```
# PromQL samples
sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (host)
avg_over_time(kv_residency_percentile{quantile="0.5"}[10m])
(sum(rate(kv_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_requests_total[5m]))) * 100
```

Sample scrape snapshot:
```
kv_evictions_total{host="i-23"} 18
kv_residency_percentile{quantile="0.5"} 0.685
kv_hits_total 34500
kv_requests_total 50600
```

Tom: We need eviction age buckets. Right now evictions_total hides whether we're dropping tiny recent fragments or large long-lived ones. A 0-1s / 1-5s / 5-30s / 30s+ split would help triage. Also a paging heatmap by token-length would be useful.

Emily: I also ran an allocator profile. Small fragments (~256B) are dominating free lists during the peak. Profiler top of flame:
```
# pprof top (sample)
30.2%  kv_fragment_alloc
18.7%  kv_page_coalesce
12.4%  memcopy
```

Raj: Hypothesis: coalescing reduces long-lived fragmentation but increases short-lived page churn at prefix boundaries. If coalesce triggers on very small fragments aggressively, we might be creating more short-lived allocations. Could gate coalescing by fragment_age or reuse_count.

Sofia: For dashboards I'd add: kv_eviction_age_bucket{le=...}, kv_fragment_size_histogram, kv_residency_percentiles (p50/p90/p99), kv_pagechain_coalesces_total. Also add a per-host heatmap: pages_evicted_by_token_length.

Sofia: Suggested alert: rate(kv_evictions_total[5m]) > 50 -> paging-churn-pager (because >50/s correlates with latency spikes in replay tests).

infra-bot: canary-deploy: pagechain-coalesce v2 deployed to staging at 2650012358 :white_check_mark:

Emily: Next steps: (1) add eviction-age histogram + fragment-size histogram to Grafana, (2) export pagechain_coalesce counters on the worker, (3) run 24h replay with coalesce gating (age>2s or reuse_count>3) and collect full traces. I'll open a metrics PR and a small config PR for the gating. cc @Raj @Sofia

Raj: :thumbsup: I can prototype the Prometheus exporter patch this afternoon and wire the histogram buckets.

Tom: If you want, I can sketch a lightweight sampling profiler to catch coalesce events tied to requests so we can correlate which user flows trigger the churn.

Emily: That would be awesome. Thanks everyone — will drop links to the PRs and the staging Grafana dashboard once I have them.
